check.rule: the calibration is usable only when tau >= 0.5, that is, when at least 95 % of train_core crops are judged more plant than non-plant (P(plant) >= 0.5); otherwise the prompts do not separate genuine weeds from the non-plant set, the file is written for a person to read, and relevance.load refuses it

calibration.set: every train_core crop with a feature (crops.csv set 'core'); all genuine weeds

notes: calibration.check: tau must be >= 0.5, else relevance.load refuses this file.
rule: tau = the 5th percentile of P(plant) over every train_core crop with a feature; a source passes when the median P(plant) of its sample (up to --sample crops with a feature, seeded) is >= tau; a source with fewer than 20 crops with a feature is insufficient and does not pass

The per-source tables are empty: the cluster file's per-source scores were not pulled, and neither relevance.load (it refuses the file at its calibration check first) nor the autopilot (D2b is silent on a calibration-failed file) reads them.
